items.requirement: Memory access token and HttpOnly refresh cookie; strict CSP
evidence: Browser access JWT now has a fifteen-minute lifetime and stays only in Pinia memory. Historical localStorage credentials are removed without being read; profiles are also memory-only.

Login creates a hash-only Redis refresh family with a seven-day absolute expiry. Host-only Strict HttpOnly cookie uses Secure and __Host- under HTTPS; non-localhost HTTP is refused. Every refresh rotates with atomic Lua; replay revokes the family, including signed access JWTs. Password version/deleted account checks use current PostgreSQL scalar state.

Refresh/logout require the exact configured Origin plus a non-simple CSRF header. Login rejects foreign origins. Logout clears the cookie only after revocation succeeds; a signed access-family fallback handles a missing cookie. Runtime UI tickets bind the parent login family and become invalid immediately after logout.

Frontend restores via Cookie before route guards, coalesces same-tab refreshes, serializes login/refresh/logout with cross-tab Web Locks, and retries expired API requests once with a fresh header. Temporary failures retain retryable state; late refresh cannot overwrite a newer login and another-tab account switch clears identity/workspace context.
